-- 1. Delete the child line items tied to that transaction reference
DELETE FROM purchase_line_items 
WHERE transaction_id IN (SELECT id FROM purchase_transactions WHERE ref_id = 'PUR-000001');

-- 2. Delete the parent transaction record
DELETE FROM purchase_transactions WHERE ref_id = 'PUR-000001';

-- 3. Remove any auto-generated interest expense associated with it
DELETE FROM opex_expenses WHERE item_description LIKE '%PUR-000001%';
